build_note: Listed 6-5, 207 lb (Wikipedia); 6-8 wingspan at the 2021 combine (NBADraft.net)
story: The Lakers' eighth straight win. Phoenix won the fourth quarter 43–27.
aria: Original illustration of Quentin Grimes' pull-up 3-pointer off the glass with 32 seconds left that put the Lakers up 129–121 against the Suns in a 131–123 win, after Phoenix cut a 31-point lead to 5. Not traced from footage, not to scale.
